amendment: The earlier clean-readout amendment from SAGA to deterministic L-BFGS remains in force. After the scientific runner entered the real stage, only technical failure traces and execution state were inspected; no partial condition outcomes, aggregates, inference results, or paper outputs were inspected. Two algebraically equivalent numerical corrections replace an ill-conditioned Bures Gram eigendecomposition with a factor SVD and replace a generic SVD of the symmetric Bures rank correction with eigenpairs ordered by absolute eigenvalue. The extra rank-256 diagnostic is removed because, at low n and high d, it provably splits a materially nonzero repeated OAS nullspace and therefore has no intrinsic rank-256 downstream value. Rank-64 remains prespecified but is evaluated only at n>=1024, where the calibration sample size reaches the encoder dimensions; rank-4 and the full/empirical covariance estimators retain the complete finite-sample grid. A fail-closed cutoff-tie gate prevents any retained rank result from silently selecting a solver-dependent slice of a nonzero repeated eigenspace. A subsequent failure of the paired readout-gauge SVD at 64 pairs exposed a distinct identifiability problem rather than a resource issue: its task-weighted cross matrix is rank bounded by both the centered pair span and centered readout rank, so a full orthogonal completion is not identified and a replacement decomposition would silently impose a solver-dependent estimator. The real paired readout-gauge diagnostic was therefore withdrawn. Full paired Procrustes was retained provisionally at 4096 pairs behind a mandatory full-centered-cross-rank gate. That gate subsequently rejected a DINOv3 condition because its centered cross rank was 1023 rather than the 1024-dimensional feature rank. Having more pairs than dimensions is necessary but not sufficient for a unique polar factor; choosing a numerical nullspace completion after this failure would define a new estimator. Paired Procrustes and its shuffled variant are therefore withdrawn uniformly from the real confirmatory suite. The correspondence-dose curve uses regularized paired ridge and reduced-rank ridge with estimator-matched shuffled controls. The confirmatory correspondence suite retains reduced-rank ridge, its shuffled control, and assignment-erased endpoint-matched Bures. The two locked correspondence contrasts were already reduced-rank ridge versus shuffled pairs and reduced-rank ridge versus endpoint-matched Bures, so their inferential family is unchanged. Reduced-rank ridge also fails closed if its rank-64 cutoff splits a materially nonzero repeated singular subspace. Primary marginal endpoints, all data, seeds, metrics, claim policies, and the number of locked correspondence contrasts are unchanged. Exact incidents are recorded in implementation_corrections.json, and the amended campaign starts in a fresh run directory.
scientific_question: How much frozen-task recovery is identified by increasingly rich unpaired endpoint marginals, and what changes when sample correspondence is supplied?
claim_policy: No universal pointwise accuracy ceiling is claimed from endpoint marginals alone.
Exact quantitative ceilings are minimax/Bayes values over explicitly indistinguishable compatible worlds.
Approximate-symmetry bounds are stated on the joint observable law available to the decision rule.
CORAL and Bures are parallel covariance-gauge representatives, not successive information tiers.
Paired diagnostics are not called oracles or upper bounds when estimated from finite samples.
All unfavorable, failed, and nonidentifiable conditions remain in raw outputs and aggregate reports.
protocol_invariants: Frozen encoder and frozen reference-trained readout for every marginal/correspondence method.
Target labels are unavailable except to the explicitly labeled-ER comparator and evaluation.
One fixed held-out evaluation identity set per dataset/encoder/split seed across every calibration and pair budget.
Reference and target marginal endpoint samples are selected independently; their row assignment is not exposed.
Calibration pools are nested by budget and disjoint from evaluation identities.
Every true-pair estimator has an algorithm-matched shuffled-pair control.
Paired results require identity evidence stronger than label equality or assumed row order.
Feature/cache reuse requires a complete content-keyed manifest and exact hash match.
All aggregate results report their unit of variation and retain raw condition rows.
secondary_analyses: all-corruption severity breadth at levels 1, 3, and 5
exact Gaussian-halfspace and finite-group ceilings over explicitly indistinguishable worlds
approximate two-world bounds using the joint law of all calibration observations
positive standardized asymmetric-mixture regime in which higher-order marginals identify the hidden swap
finite-pair centered-rank thresholds at d-1, d, d+1, and d+8
controlled real-embedding group orbits reporting unrestricted Bayes and achievable group-map minimax values separately
prespecified higher-order real-feature panel (descriptive, outside the Holm family)
all-corruption severity-5 matched true-versus-shuffled correspondence confirmation
strict predict-before-update streaming audit with cumulative and 64/256/1024-row windows
failure_policy: Fail closed, preserve FAILED stage manifest and logs, and resume only after all prior PASS output hashes verify. Missing required caches or pairing evidence is a technical failure, not a skipped condition.
